name: webscrcpy
description: Browser-based Android screen mirroring and control on Bun + vanilla scrcpy-server

scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun build --compile --minify --asset-naming="[name].[ext]" src/server/index.ts --outfile dist/webscrcpy
scripts.start: bun run build:web && bun run src/server/index.ts
